oliver: Heads-up — Lighthouse (lighthouse-6b) is going GA to Hosted today 18:00 PT. Posting a short ops + migration callout. Please read and flag anything urgent. :lighthouse:

oliver: TL;DR:
- New route: POST /v1/generate/lighthouse
- Streaming + tool-calling enabled by default
- Canary plan: 6% for 20m -> 30% for 40m -> 100% if green (~2.5h)
- Unpinned keys: soft per-key RPS change 10 -> 8 rps, burst 20 -> 16
- Old route (/v1/generate/zephyr) will be supported for 45 days; deprecation header added on day 1

nina: Ops checklist (short):
- Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/hosted/lighthouse (examples + SDK snippets)
- Rollback quick commands:
```
redwoodctl deploy set-backend lighthouse --version previous --force
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate/lighthouse --weight 0
```
- Pager triggers: p50 latency > 140ms OR 5xx > 0.6% sustained for 5m

carlos: Runtime note: lighthouse-6b uses the tiled-kv cache path and int8-qdq profile. ML validated on our eval suite; please report hallucination or quality regressions to #eng-ml-evals.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2025-11-02T18:00:12Z — allocation lighthouse-hosted-a:6%

qa-bot: Canary health quick checks (automated): success rate 99.6%, p50 118ms, p95 312ms. Will re-run full suite at +25m.

oliver: Client snippet for SDK/quickstarts (pasteable):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate/lighthouse" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Write a short explainer","stream":true,"tool_calls":["http_call"]}'
```
Note: keys that pin to /v1/generate/zephyr will remain on zephyr until customers change config.

oliver: Monitoring: Console > Models > lighthouse-6b (watch error rate, latency buckets, tokens/sec). If you see client-facing regressions escalate to #incidents and ping me directly for quota exceptions. Thanks all — steady launch :rocket:
